entities.summary: Georg Julius von Schultz, also known under his pseudonym Dr. Bertram, was a prominent Estophile of Baltic German heritage. A friend of Friedrich Reinhold Kreutzwald, he was instrumental in the latter's decision to develop Kalevipoeg.
